summary_en: Acquisition of 100% stake in Tanabe Pharma Factory from Tanabe Pharma, subsidiary of BCJ-94. Effective July 3, 2026. Covers all shares; inheritance of manufacturing and sales approval for 17 active ingredients (35 products). Rationale: strengthen stable supply capability, enhance manufacturing and quality control systems, expand product portfolio via consolidation with existing TOWA products.
title_en: Notification of Acquisition of All Shares of Tanabe Pharma Factory Co., Ltd. from Tanabe Pharma Co., Ltd. (Complete Subsidiary Status) and Succession of Manufacturing and Sales Approvals
translation_en_brief:
TOWA Pharmaceutical announced on July 3, 2026 a board resolution to acquire 100% of the shares of Tanabe Pharma Factory Co., Ltd. from Tanabe Pharma Co., Ltd. and make it a wholly owned subsidiary, effective the same date. Tanabe Pharma Factory, established in 2008, is a pharmaceutical manufacturer with capital of 100 million yen and reported FY3/26 revenues of 15.8 billion yen and net income of 545 million yen. The acquisition includes succession of manufacturing and sales approvals for 17 active ingredients across 35 products.

TOWA cited two strategic rationales: first, strengthening its domestic generic pharmaceutical supply infrastructure by integrating Tanabe Pharma Factory's advanced manufacturing controls and quality assurance systems (built to global standards); second, expanding TOWA's product portfolio through consolidation of overlapping SKUs and capturing manufacturing efficiencies, while preserving proprietary manufacturing technologies and know-how accumulated by the originator (Tanabe Pharma). The seller, Tanabe Pharma, is 100% owned by BCJ-94 and currently outsources manufacturing to TOWA.

No share count, purchase price, or premium disclosure appears in the filing. The transaction appears fully funded but the consideration structure is not specified.
